# UniFuse-derived implementation

The files in this directory are adapted from the UniFuse reference
implementation by Jiang et al. (2021). The upstream license is retained in
`LICENSE`. This directory is part of the model implementation and includes
project-specific changes for the gated ERP/Cubemap backbone and input stems.

Upstream paper: H. Jiang et al., “UniFuse: Unidirectional Fusion for 360°
Panorama Depth Estimation,” IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters, 2021.

Before publishing, add the exact upstream repository URL and revision used for
this copy, and keep all upstream notices intact.
